SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT distinct CSTMR_ID, ORDR_NO FROM KEPMPSO06 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKFNT0001C001') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('SS03') ORDER BY CSTMR_ID, ORDR_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT DECODE(SO06.USE_CHK,'N','D','C') AS STATUS, NVL(SO06.IF_ORDR_NO ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(SO04.IF_ORDR_MNG_NO ,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, GETALANCINFO(SO06.SPPLR_ID,'BIZ_NO') AS SELLER_IRS, GETALANCINFO(SO06.SPPLR_ID,'ALANC_NM') AS SELLER_NAME FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPMPSO04 SO04 WHERE SO06.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = SO04.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO AND SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ = SO04.ORDR_RE_SEQ ORDER BY SO06.CSTMR_ID, SO06.ORDR_NO, SO06.ORDR_SEQ
UPDATE KEPMPSO06 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$'
UPDATE KEPMPSO06 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$'
